speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned you have a rash on your scalp and forehead; can you tell me exactly what it looks like, how long it has been there, and if you have been experiencing any itching or pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Psoriasis.

Based on the patient's age, the chronic and scaly nature of the rash, its exacerbation in cold weather, and the family history of psoriasis, I am confident in this diagnosis. I will not proceed with further testing as the clinical presentation is classic.
